reasons: Whether an ADU is allowed depends on building type and zone. Rowhouses allow it only inside the house. Twin house, House A in N3 and N4, House B and House C allow it in the house or an outbuilding (Article 4 tables, part F)
No ADU in House A in GX-C, GX-N, NX or N2, in Lane rowhouse, Small general, General, Storefront or Commercial center buildings (Article 4 tables, part F, dash means not allowed)
Outbuilding height: two stories or the height of the house, whichever is less. Floor-to-floor rules of the house apply (660-49G). No feet number. Ask the Zoning Officer for the height in feet
Only one street-facing entrance on a house with an ADU, unless a second one existed before (660-42C(8)(b))
Outbuildings on lots under 15,000 sq ft in an N zone: two at most (660-49E)
Code slip: 660-86A points to 660-44B for ADU parking, but the ADU rule is 660-42C(7) and 660-44 is EV charging
District height for N5 not on file in feet. Height of a unit in the house not known
No height number on file for a detached unit. Ask the zoning officer
Condition: Both units combined: one household plus two more adults. In the Student Residence Overlay, no more than two students. (660-42C(6))
Condition: At least one of the dwelling units ... must be occupied by a record owner of the subject property. (660-42C(10))
Condition: ADUs only on a lot occupied by one dwelling unit. (660-42C(1)(a))
Condition: Floor area of the principal unit and the ADU combined must be at least 1,750 sq ft. (660-42C(1)(b))
Condition: A record owner lives in one of the units for most of the year. Affidavit and recorded deed restriction before the permit. (660-42C(10), 660-42C(12))
Condition: Outbuilding with an ADU on a permanent foundation. Only one street-facing entrance on the house. (660-42C(8)(a), 660-42C(8)(b))
Condition: Accessory buildings of 250 sq ft or more seen from an A or B street match the house roof type and materials. (660-41B(7))
Condition: Outbuilding water and sewer must tie to the house. Separate connections prohibited. PA DEP evaluates the sewer connection. (660-49H, 660-42C(2))

Condition: House A and House B lots need at least 3,500 sq ft and 40 ft of width in N3 and N4 (House B also in N5). The twin house needs 1,800 sq ft. 660-42 sets no ADU lot minimum. A smaller existing lot may be nonconforming. Ask the zoning officer (660-29D, 660-30D, 660-28D, 660-42C(1))
Parking: House plus ADU: 3 spaces in total in N3, N4, N5 and GX zones (2 for the house under Table 660-10, plus 1 for the ADU). 2 in total in N1 and N2, where the house needs 1.
